breakdown.description: Ideal-gas normal-shock relations are applied to liquid water without a valid equation of state/model.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that applying ideal-gas relations to liquid water is physically inconsistent. It resolved this by changing the working fluid to 'water vapor treated as an ideal gas'. This is a valid correction that makes the physics of the problem solvable with the specified relations, aligning with the ground truth's intent of using a gas ('air') instead of a liquid.
